title: Shattered Celluloid Mirror
description: A woman in a flowing silver gown stands before a large, ornate black mirror with dramatic golden cracks, her reflection showing a horrified expression as she clutches her chest. The checkered floor is littered with torn film reels, scattered photographs, and red ribbons under dramatic beams of light from above.
